project_target: CZ1, r45-60km, both source and receiver around z200m; T2-A/B new resources hypothetical only

physical_original_audit.old_model: historical E-STD Munk-like SSP, 5000m, vacuum surface V, rigid bottom R, CVWT/Thorp printed, water rho1
physical_original_audit.old_N2_window: T2-N2 CHIGH 1800/2000/2400 materially different; independent SCOOTER/FIELDS not evaluated
physical_original_audit.cp_classification: cp greater than max SSP(c(z)) means kz(z)^2=(omega/c(z))^2-(omega/cp)^2 positive everywhere in water, without internal water-column turning point

analytic_ideal_waveguide.purpose: method-level verification and boundary sensitivity, never a site/ocean/CZ physics truth

analytic_ideal_waveguide.attenuation: zero, NO Thorp for analytic reference (historical E-STD remains CVWT)
analytic_ideal_waveguide.analytic_extra_comparison: ALL_PROPAGATING (analytic only; never label CHIGH=4000 complete)
analytic_ideal_waveguide.scoring: per resource, probe and frequency one unknown common complex scalar removed across 8/12 channels; independent raw global scalar across 5 probes for each boundary/frequency/window

E_STD_mathematical_bottom_sensitivity.bottom_new: V vacuum/pressure release at 5000m; MATHEMATICAL EXTREME, NOT realistic measured seabed
E_STD_mathematical_bottom_sensitivity.bottom_old: R perfectly rigid, original N2 K2 modal field
allowed_env_changes: bottom boundary single R->V line only
E_STD_mathematical_bottom_sensitivity.retained_options: historical CVWT / Thorp SSP and water density identical to N2 K2, unlike ideal analytic control
E_STD_mathematical_bottom_sensitivity.outputs: raw relative change; phase-profiled spatial shape; source depth, target range, bearing, array label; no determination of real-world better bottom

stop_policy: One Commit A freezing all source/env/params then one serial gated run, cold audit, Commit B push and STOP; partial results preserved; no second attempts or gate relaxation
